title: Slow Motion Click
vars: The original click stretched four times: a quarter second, pitch two octaves down. Then the quiet siren.
Eight times: half a second, three octaves down. The snap becomes a thud, the settle a rumble.
Sixteen times: a full second, four octaves down. More a door than a click.
The ten-times click from last round, slowed four times: about a second of ring.
